lines.text: During the night Jacob took his two wives, two maidservants, and eleven sons across the ford of the Jabbok.
Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him until daybreak and struck the socket of his hip.
Jacob refused to let the man go without a blessing, and the man renamed him Abraham because he prevailed.
The man blessed Jacob there, and Jacob named the place Bethel, saying he had seen God face to face.
The sun rose as Jacob passed Penuel limping because of his hip, and Israelites still do not eat that tendon.
